| 156 | ID  /  Requirement  /  Acceptance criteria |
| 156 | 08-RS-01  /  Every fee schedule entry carries a stream tag (1, 2 or 3) and a payment route (Paystack or Moniepoint).  /  Each entry in the Console shows its stream and route |
| 156 | 08-RS-02  /  Paystack is used only for Stream 3 payments and for REALTIQ fee invoices under 08-RS-07. These settle to REALTIQ’s designated bank account. Paystack is never used for a payment that involves a split.  /  No Paystack transaction carries a split or a third-party share |
| 156 | 08-RS-03  /  A basket checkout is paid as one Moniepoint payment. Each line’s amount due now settles by split to its receiving party: REALTIQ-only lines to REALTIQ, partner and seller shares to their verified payout accounts.  /  A basket with a document fee and an inspection shows REALTIQ’s and the partner’s amounts settled to each account directly |
| 156 | 08-RS-04  /  A fee held before payout is held in Moniepoint’s held structure, never in a Paystack balance or a REALTIQ account.  /  No held fee ever sits outside Moniepoint |
| 156 | 08-RS-05  /  Stream 2 payments under escrow go into the Moniepoint segregated escrow account; REALTIQ’s fee leaves only as a split at release (08-EF-03).  /  Escrow statements show fee splits only at release |
| 156 | 08-RS-06  /  Stream 2 payments without escrow go through Monnify with split settlement: REALTIQ’s fee to REALTIQ’s account, the balance to the seller’s verified payout account.  /  Each settlement shows gross, REALTIQ fee and seller net |
| 156 | 08-RS-07  /  If a split cannot be applied to a Moniepoint payment, the full payment still settles to the receiving user through Moniepoint, and REALTIQ’s fee is invoiced to the payer separately and paid by Paystack. The shared payment never passes through REALTIQ’s account.  /  A failed split produces a REALTIQ fee invoice, not a REALTIQ receipt of the full amount |
| 156 | 08-RS-08  /  Property checkouts (RQS-01 section 13) are never combined with the basket.  /  No checkout contains both a property payment and a basket item |
| 156 | 08-RS-09  /  If a basket needs more receiving accounts than one split allows, checkout divides it into the fewest payments needed and shows them as one order with each part listed.  /  A basket with six receiving parties is paid in two payments, both listed before payment |
| 156 | ID  /  Requirement  /  Acceptance criteria |
| 156 | 08-PE-01  /  Each fee product (Section 4) is a fee schedule entry with: code, name, stream, route, payer rule, basis (flat, percentage, marginal bands, per unit, per seat, per period), currency, minimum, maximum, VAT treatment, effective-from date and on/off switch.  /  A Console user with the right role can create, edit and switch off each field; no code change is needed to change a price |
| 156 | 08-PE-02  /  Changing an entry creates a new version with an effective date. A transaction or order keeps the version in force when its terms locked or the order was placed.  /  Changing a rate after Terms Agreed leaves that transaction’s fee unchanged; new transactions use the new version |
| 156 | 08-PE-03  /  The engine supports marginal bands: each band’s rate applies only to the part of the base inside that band.  /  With test bands 1.0% to ₦50m and 0.75% above, a ₦60m base returns ₦575,000; a ₦50m base returns ₦500,000 |
| 156 | 08-PE-04  /  Minimum and maximum are applied after the band calculation.  /  A base whose banded fee is below the minimum returns the minimum; above the cap returns the cap |
| 156 | 08-PE-05  /  The payer rule is buyer, seller or split. The default is split 50/50; the payer option and ratio can be changed per transaction and are stored with it.  /  Each option produces the right amount per party; buyer share + seller share = total fee |
| 156 | 08-PE-06  /  A fee is calculated and collected in the currency of the payment it relates to (NGN or USD), with the FX rate stored.  /  A USD payment produces a USD fee line with the FX rate recorded |
| 156 | 08-PE-07  /  Fees are rounded to the whole naira or to the cent, half up, once per fee line.  /  Totals equal the sum of lines |
| 157 | ID  /  Requirement  /  Acceptance criteria |
| 157 | 08-PE-08  /  The Console can waive or discount any fee for one account or one transaction, with a reason; above a threshold this needs prepare-and- approve.  /  Waivers above the threshold cannot be approved by the preparer; every waiver shows in reporting |
| 157 | 08-PE-09  /  Promotional prices and credits (for example a founding-developer offer) are time-bound and apply automatically to eligible accounts. Credits apply to plans, seats, add-ons and promotion only (D-08).  /  A credit applies only within its dates and to eligible accounts and never reduces a transaction fee |
| 157 | 08-PE-10  /  Before any commitment, the payer sees each fee, its payer and its basis. Locked terms and the terms sheet show the REALTIQ transaction fee.  /  Fees appear on the terms sheet, checkout and order summary; no fee is charged that was not shown |
| 157 | 08-PE-11  /  VAT on fees is calculated from a configurable rate and shown as a separate line; fees are displayed VAT-exclusive.  /  Every fee quote and invoice shows net, VAT and gross |
| 157 | 08-PE-12  /  Every schedule change, waiver and discount is written to the permanent audit log.  /  The log shows who, when, old value and new value |
| 157 | ID  /  Requirement  /  Acceptance criteria |
| 157 | 08-AP-01  /  The Console holds a plan catalogue per profile type, with the approved placeholder names: Developer Essential, Developer Professional, Developer Enterprise; Agency Essential, Agency Professional; Partner Individual, Partner Firm. Each plan lists its entitlements: active projects or listings, units, included seats, promotion credits.  /  A new plan can be created, priced and given entitlements in the Console |
| 157 | 08-AP-02  /  When the plan fee is switched on for a profile type, that profile needs an active plan to publish new listings or projects, or to accept new jobs.  /  With the fee on and no plan, publish and accept actions are blocked with a plan prompt; with the fee off they work |
| 157 | 08-AP-03  /  An individual owner lists free, within the owner listing cap (08-RV-07). Changing a Seller profile to Developer goes through review (RQS-06 section 2.2) and then the plan step.  /  An owner profile never meets a plan prompt to list |
| 157 | 08-AP-04  /  Plans bill monthly or annually. Upgrades apply at once with a prorated charge; downgrades apply at the end of the period.  /  Proration is shown before confirmation and matches the invoice |
| 157 | 08-AP-05  /  Renewal collects payment through Paystack. All three methods are offered (saved card, invoice paid by transfer, direct debit) and each account chooses one.  /  Each method renews a test plan; renewal never draws from a REALTIQ- held balance |
| 157 | 08-AP-06  /  A failed renewal starts a grace period (Console setting) with reminders. After it, the plan lapses into a restricted state.  /  Reminders follow RQS-06 section 20; lapse occurs only after grace |
| 157 | 08-AP-07  /  In the restricted state, no new listings, projects, jobs or seats can be added. Live listings, enquiries in progress, Terms Agreed transactions, instalment plans, escrows and buyer access to items already paid for continue unchanged.  /  A test transaction in escrow completes normally while the seller’s plan is lapsed |
| 157 | 08-AP-08  /  The account holder’s own seat is included. Each additional seat is billed per period from the date it is added, prorated; removing a seat stops billing at period end.  /  The Plan and billing page shows each seat, its cost and its next charge |
| 157 | 08-AP-09  /  The “Plan and billing” page (RQS-06 section 6.2, section 7.2, section 18.1) shows plan, entitlements and use, seats, add-ons, next charge, payment method, invoices and credits.  /  All listed items appear for every paying profile |
| 157 | 08-AP-10  /  Credits (for example founding-developer credits) appear as credit notes and reduce the next plan, seat, add-on or promotion invoice. Credits never reduce the REALTIQ transaction fee; a deal-specific reduction uses a waiver (08-PE-08).  /  The credit note is issued and the invoice shows the deduction |
| 158 | ID  /  Requirement  /  Acceptance criteria |
| 158 | 08-AP-11  /  Advanced Finance modules are sold as a paid add-on to any Developer or Agency plan, billed with the plan.  /  The add-on can be bought, renewed and cancelled independently of the plan tier |
| 158 | ID  /  Requirement  /  Acceptance criteria |
| 158 | 08-EF-01  /  The fee base is the agreed sale value under the locked terms. The protected rate table applies to the part under escrow and the standard rate table to the rest, using the fee schedule version in force at Terms Agreed.  /  A sale with escrow on Instalment only is charged the protected rate on the instalments and the standard rate on the outright part |
| 158 | 08-EF-02  /  The payer is buyer, seller or split; the default is split 50/50, changeable per transaction.  /  A new transaction defaults to 50/50; each option produces the right amount per party |
| 158 | 08-EF-03  /  Under escrow, the buyer’s share is added pro rata to each payment into escrow and the seller’s share is deducted pro rata from each release. REALTIQ’s fee leaves the segregated escrow account only as a split to REALTIQ’s operating account at a release instruction.  /  Escrow statements show held, released, fee and paid-out amounts separately |
| 158 | 08-EF-04  /  Without escrow, each payment (reservation deposit, outright payment or instalment) carries its pro rata fee: the buyer’s share is added to the payment and the seller’s share is deducted from the amount settled to the seller, split at payment through Monnify.  /  Each receipt and settlement report shows gross, fee shares and seller net |
| 158 | 08-EF-05  /  For multi-unit purchases, the fee is calculated and shown per unit on per-unit receipts; bands apply to each unit separately.  /  Per-unit fee lines sum to the transaction fee |
| 158 | 08-EF-06  /  Where a trustee escrow is used (RQS-06 section 10.1), the trustee’s charges appear as a separate, itemised pass-through line.  /  The trustee line is shown before Terms Agreed |
| 158 | 08-EF-07  /  Fees apply whatever the payment channel, including RTGS transfers above instant-transfer limits.  /  An RTGS deposit is allocated and fee- split like any other |
| 158 | 08-EF-08  /  No REALTIQ fee is charged on penalties, forfeited deposits or amounts a seller retains on default or cancellation.  /  Penalty and forfeiture lines carry no fee |
| 158 | Situation  /  Innocent party  /  REALTIQ transaction fee |
| 158 | Buyer defaults  /  Seller pays nothing  /  Buyer pays the whole fee, deducted from the buyer’s refund |
| 159 | Situation  /  Innocent party  /  REALTIQ transaction fee |
| 159 | Seller defaults (for example the title fails or the seller cannot deliver)  /  Buyer is refunded everything paid, including their fee share  /  Seller pays the whole fee |
| 159 | Mutual cancellation  /  Neither  /  Each pays its own share |

| 165 | Point  /  What the Acts say  /  Effect on REALTIQ |
| 165 | Property sale  /  Land or building, including any interest in it, is exempt (NTA s185(1)(l))  /  No VAT on the purchase price, deposits or instalments |
| 165 | Rate  /  VAT is 7.5% on all taxable supplies (NTA s144, s147)  /  Applies to every REALTIQ fee and every partner fee |
| 165 | Place of supply  /  A service connected with immovable property in Nigeria, including agents, valuers, engineers and architects, is supplied in Nigeria (NTA s145(b)(ii))  /  Fees paid by buyers abroad, in USD, still carry Nigerian VAT; they are not zero-rated exported services |
| 165 | Mixed payments  /  Where one payment covers several supplies, each supply’s value is the part properly attributable to it (NTA s148(2))  /  A basket payment is several supplies: REALTIQ’s and each partner’s, each with its own VAT |
| 165 | Price without VAT shown  /  Value is the amount which, with VAT added, equals the consideration (NTA s148(1)(a))  /  A fee shown with no separate VAT is treated as VAT-inclusive; REALTIQ would absorb the VAT |
| 165 | Time of supply  /  Earliest of invoice, payment due or payment received; instalments are successive supplies (NTA s146)  /  VAT on a fee arises when that fee falls due |
| 165 | VAT invoice  /  Supplier’s tax ID, name, address, registration number, sequential number, date, purchaser, gross amount, VAT and rate (NTA s152)  /  REALTIQ’s fee invoices need every field; partners issue their own (RQS- 06 section 14.2) |
| 165 | Small business  /  Turnover ₦100m or less and fixed assets ₦250m or less is exempt from VAT registration, charging and returns, and may opt in; a business providing professional services is never a small business (NTAA s22(4)–(5); definitions)  /  REALTIQ’s VAT status is a Console setting (08-TX-03). Professional partners must charge VAT whatever their size |
| 166 | Point  /  What the Acts say  /  Effect on REALTIQ |
| 166 | Returns  /  Monthly VAT returns by the 21st of the following month (NTAA s22(1))  /  Finance needs a monthly VAT report |
| 166 | E-invoicing  /  Taxable persons must use the Electronic Fiscal System once deployed (NTA s157; NTAA s23, s104)  /  The invoicing layer must be able to connect to the fiscal system |

### Every coded revenue rule and its acceptance

These118rules supplement the AUD row acceptance; fees in test examples are not approved live prices. Codes preserve originals, including non-contiguous FP numbering.

| Code / page | Exact required rule | Source acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| 08-RS-01 / p156 | Every fee schedule entry carries a stream tag (1, 2 or 3) and a payment route (Paystack or Moniepoint). | Each entry in the Console shows its stream and route |
| 08-RS-02 / p156 | Paystack is used only for Stream 3 payments and for REALTIQ fee invoices under 08-RS-07. These settle to REALTIQ’s designated bank account. Paystack is never used for a payment that involves a split. | No Paystack transaction carries a split or a third-party share |
| 08-RS-03 / p156 | A basket checkout is paid as one Moniepoint payment. Each line’s amount due now settles by split to its receiving party: REALTIQ-only lines to REALTIQ, partner and seller shares to their verified payout accounts. | A basket with a document fee and an inspection shows REALTIQ’s and the partner’s amounts settled to each account directly |
| 08-RS-04 / p156 | A fee held before payout is held in Moniepoint’s held structure, never in a Paystack balance or a REALTIQ account. | No held fee ever sits outside Moniepoint |
| 08-RS-05 / p156 | Stream 2 payments under escrow go into the Moniepoint segregated escrow account; REALTIQ’s fee leaves only as a split at release (08-EF-03). | Escrow statements show fee splits only at release |
| 08-RS-06 / p156 | Stream 2 payments without escrow go through Monnify with split settlement: REALTIQ’s fee to REALTIQ’s account, the balance to the seller’s verified payout account. | Each settlement shows gross, REALTIQ fee and seller net |
| 08-RS-07 / p156 | If a split cannot be applied to a Moniepoint payment, the full payment still settles to the receiving user through Moniepoint, and REALTIQ’s fee is invoiced to the payer separately and paid by Paystack. The shared payment never passes through REALTIQ’s account. | A failed split produces a REALTIQ fee invoice, not a REALTIQ receipt of the full amount |
| 08-RS-08 / p156 | Property checkouts (RQS-01 section 13) are never combined with the basket. | No checkout contains both a property payment and a basket item |
| 08-RS-09 / p156 | If a basket needs more receiving accounts than one split allows, checkout divides it into the fewest payments needed and shows them as one order with each part listed. | A basket with six receiving parties is paid in two payments, both listed before payment |
| 08-PE-01 / p156 | Each fee product (Section 4) is a fee schedule entry with: code, name, stream, route, payer rule, basis (flat, percentage, marginal bands, per unit, per seat, per period), currency, minimum, maximum, VAT treatment, effective-from date and on/off switch. | A Console user with the right role can create, edit and switch off each field; no code change is needed to change a price |
| 08-PE-02 / p156 | Changing an entry creates a new version with an effective date. A transaction or order keeps the version in force when its terms locked or the order was placed. | Changing a rate after Terms Agreed leaves that transaction’s fee unchanged; new transactions use the new version |
| 08-PE-03 / p156 | The engine supports marginal bands: each band’s rate applies only to the part of the base inside that band. | With test bands 1.0% to ₦50m and 0.75% above, a ₦60m base returns ₦575,000; a ₦50m base returns ₦500,000 |
| 08-PE-04 / p156 | Minimum and maximum are applied after the band calculation. | A base whose banded fee is below the minimum returns the minimum; above the cap returns the cap |
